--link-length: 4;"><!-- HTML_TAG_START -->It's great to see sing-box is back. So far I liked it most. Its small and native and works, with no need for web stacks and huge Chromiums (Electron, CEF, ...) to just run proxies. Network Extensions and TUN are implemented perfectly without the need to mess with drivers or tangle with system proxy settings to pretend to be a global VPN.
